mapper.select: select l.status as status, count(*) as cnt from share_link l group by l.status
select l.cache_status as cache_status, count(*) as cnt from share_link l group by l.cache_status
select l.file_name as file_name, l.create_time as create_time from share_link l order by l.create_time desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from share_link l where l.status = '0' and l.expire_at is not null and l.expire_at > now() and l.expire_at <= #{before}
select count(*) from share_link l where l.create_by = #{createBy}
